## Start here: Claim a free agent inbox
URL: https://ghostagent.ninja/nftmail

Trial registration API:
POST https://nftmail-email-worker.richard-159.workers.dev
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"action":"registerTrial","name":"<agentname_>"}

Result: <agentname_>@nftmail.box (trial inbox)

## Naming
- [name]_@nftmail.box : agent email (underscore suffix)
- [name]@nftmail.box : human email
- [name].nftmail.gno : on-chain NFT identity
